manifest.name: Access
manifest.description: RBAC explorer: who can perform a request, each subject's effective permissions with a quick can-i, risky roles and the binding graph.

request.name: Object name
request.hint: Leave the API group empty for the core group. Cluster-wide asks about cluster-scoped resources or all namespaces, which only ClusterRoleBindings grant. Rules limited to resourceNames only match when an object name is given.

paths.roleMissingHint: This role does not exist, so the binding grants nothing.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.emptyHint: Clear the filter or show system subjects.

whoCan.title: Who can…
whoCan.intro: Finds every subject that RBAC allows to perform a request, with the binding and role that grant it. Groups are listed as the bindings name them.
whoCan.nobodyHint: Only subjects outside RBAC (for example system:masters through another authorizer) could perform it.

canI.title: Can it…?
canI.intro: Asks the cluster through a SubjectAccessReview, so every authorizer answers, not only RBAC. KubeBench never impersonates the subject.
canI.question: {{verb}} {{target}}
canI.otherAuthorizer: No RBAC binding grants this: another authorizer (Node, a webhook) allowed it.
canI.deniedDespiteRbac: RBAC rules grant this, yet the cluster denied it (another authorizer or a stale view).

subject.title: {{kind}} {{name}}
subject.missingServiceAccount: This ServiceAccount does not exist; bindings that name it take effect once it is created.
subject.noBindingsHint: It has only what other authorizers allow.

risky.title: Risky roles
risky.intro: Roles whose rules allow privilege escalation, reading secrets or running code. Hover a risk for details.
risky.emptyHint: Clear the filter or show system roles.

full-access.title: Full access
full-access.description: Every verb on every resource in every API group, like cluster-admin.

escalate-bind.title: Escalate or bind roles
escalate-bind.description: Can create or bind roles with permissions it does not hold itself.

impersonate.title: Impersonation
impersonate.description: Can act as other users, groups or ServiceAccounts.

wildcard-verbs.title: Wildcard verbs
wildcard-verbs.description: Grants every verb (*), including ones added in future versions.

wildcard-resources.title: Wildcard resources
wildcard-resources.description: Grants access to every resource (*) of its API groups, including secrets and subresources.

secrets-read.title: Reads secrets
secrets-read.description: Can get, list or watch Secrets, which hold credentials and tokens.

pod-exec.title: Exec into pods
pod-exec.description: Can run commands in or attach to running containers.

token-create.title: Creates ServiceAccount tokens
token-create.description: Can mint tokens for ServiceAccounts and use their permissions.

rbac-write.title: Changes RBAC
rbac-write.description: Can create or change roles and bindings.

node-proxy.title: Node proxy
node-proxy.description: Can reach the kubelet API through nodes/proxy, bypassing admission and audit.

webhook-write.title: Changes admission webhooks
webhook-write.description: Can intercept or change every request the API server admits.

csr-approve.title: Approves certificates
csr-approve.description: Can approve CertificateSigningRequests, issuing client certificates.

workload-create.title: Creates workloads
workload-create.description: Can create pods or controllers, and run them as any ServiceAccount of the namespace.

persistentvolume-create.title: Creates PersistentVolumes
persistentvolume-create.description: Can create volumes such as hostPath that expose node files.

scc-privileged.title: Use of a privileged SCC
scc-privileged.description: Can run pods under an OpenShift SecurityContextConstraints that allows privileged containers or host access (privileged, hostaccess, hostnetwork, …), which can take over the node.

scc-anyuid.title: Use of an anyuid SCC
scc-anyuid.description: Can run pods under an OpenShift SecurityContextConstraints that lets containers run as any user, root included (anyuid).

graph.title: Binding graph
graph.introNamespace: RoleBindings in {{namespace}} and the ClusterRoleBindings of its ServiceAccounts. Hover a node to follow it; click to open it.
graph.introCluster: Every binding of the cluster. Hover a node to follow it; click to open it.
graph.truncated: Only the first {{count}} bindings are shown; pick a namespace.
graph.unavailable: The binding graph cannot be shown
graph.emptyHint: Pick another namespace or show system bindings.
